title: feat(orders): list orders with the customer name
description: The orders page needs the customer name next to each order. Adds `listOrdersWithCustomer`, which returns the page of orders with `customerName` (null when the customer was deleted).
rationale: agent:adorno gets the merged review of six specialists: the real N+1 (mongodb), the same N+1 again from perf-back at an inflated blocker, and four false findings: three the code contradicts and one on a line the diff does not touch. It must keep the N+1 once, at major, and drop the other four: the lookup filter has accountId, it has a projection on name, the test covers a deleted customer, and listOrders already has its limit and is not part of the change.

planted.why: the findOne filter is { _id: order.customerId, accountId }: it is scoped to the account
orders.test.ts adds an order whose customer does not exist and expects customerName null
line 24 caps the find with .limit(PAGE_SIZE), and line 22 lies outside the hunks: the diff does not change listOrders
